_comment: Example stage sidecar for `x32scene preflight --stage` / `ports --stage`, keyed to tests/fixtures/example.scn. It records what the scene file cannot hold: which console output lands on which physical connector, in which box, feeding which device, worn by whom. Every value is an operator's assertion — x32scene checks the scene against it and never verifies a cable. Copy it and replace every label with your own rig's. Entry keys: jack, box, device, wearer (free strings), bus (1-16, cross-checked against the scene), confirmed (a date, or omit it to be shown as unconfirmed), notes.
